categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correct: Allow /, disallows admin/api, sitemap declared
Enterprise security headers: CSP, HSTS preload, X-Frame-Options DENY, Permissions-Policy

findings.title: Homepage not cacheable (Cache-Control: no-store, must-revalidate)
findings.description: Homepage renders dynamically per request with no-store, defeating CDN/browser caching for a rarely-changing marketing page. Slows TTFB/LCP and wastes crawl budget.
findings.recommendation: Render statically or with ISR (export const revalidate = 3600) so Cloudflare caches the page; verify header changes to a max-age/s-maxage policy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Trust stats present (2,893+ projects, 35 states, 89% bid win rate)

findings.title: Thin homepage content (325 words)
findings.description: Only ~325 indexable words. Insufficient to rank for competitive commercial terms (construction estimating services, KD 47) and starves AI engines of citable passages.
findings.recommendation: Add 600-900 words of substantive copy across service sections, a how-it-works narrative, differentiators, and trades/industries served.

findings.title: Testimonials section disabled
findings.description: TestimonialsSection is commented out in home-page.tsx, removing a primary E-E-A-T/social-proof signal.
findings.recommendation: Re-enable with genuine client testimonials; add aggregateRating to ProfessionalService only if authentic reviews exist.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Keyword-led title and accurate meta description

findings.title: Title length 72 characters
findings.description: Title may truncate the brand in SERPs (~60 char display limit).
findings.recommendation: Optionally shorten to keep the brand visible, e.g. 'Construction Estimating, Shop Drawings & Rendering | ACE Services'.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy jump (H3 before H1)
findings.description: An H3 ('Socials') appears before the page H1 in DOM order, breaking strict heading nesting.
findings.recommendation: Demote to a non-heading element or move it after the H1.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: @graph with Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService (full NAP/hours/geo), Service (OfferCatalog), FAQPage

findings.title: Schema stale vs. current service lineup
findings.description: OfferCatalog omits Shop Drawings and 3D Architectural Rendering (now core, and present in title/copy). Organization description still calls the company only an 'estimation company'.
findings.recommendation: Add Shop Drawings and 3D Rendering Offers; broaden Organization description; add logo and sameAs to Organization node. File: src/lib/schema.ts.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP image preload hint on logo

findings.title: Field data required; caching defeats performance
findings.description: CWV not measurable on the unoptimized dev build. The no-store homepage policy will suppress LCP/TTFB gains.
findings.recommendation: Pull CrUX/GSC field data on production and re-measure LCP after the caching fix.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clean semantic HTML + rich entity graph

findings.title: Thin body text limits passage citability
findings.description: AI engines cite extractable passages; 325 words offers little to quote.
findings.recommendation: The content expansion in Phase 1 directly increases citable surface area.
